title: Lambda to occupy Aligned's new DFW-04 AI data center in Texas

sources.quote: Lambda will occupy Aligned’s newest Dallas-Fort Worth area facility, DFW-04, which will be designed to be a liquid-cooled data center capable of supporting the highest-density Graphics Processing Units (GPUs).

explain: GPU cloud company Lambda will be the tenant of Aligned's new liquid-cooled DFW-04 data center in Plano, Texas. Lease terms were not disclosed.
